title: Balboa M7 Heater Assembly 58083

specifications.material_or_type: Stainless Steel Housing / Flo-Thru Titanium/Stainless Element

summary: The Balboa 58083 M7 heater assembly features a 5.5 kW heater element housed in stainless steel with 2" plumbing connections. It is compatible with Balboa BP, VS, and EL2001 control systems and operates on dual voltage setups.
